additional_info.subject: Notes
additional_info.body:
The charger is having many CableTempSensor errors.
This is on serval plugs.
In the last two weeks there have been 57 times CableTempSensor errors across 3 plugs. 21 times on DC1, 25 times on DC2 and 11 times on DC3. The issue is not unique to this charger we also see this on other chargers.
However this is the most extreme case.

additional_info.subject: Over Period of 3w
additional_info.body:
Error on DC1
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
Error on DC2
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)

VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
PLE:1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- too high)
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
We need to check the state monitor KF13 since it is common for DC1 and DC2.
Else we need to check the connection from Sensor of plud (XD100 & XD101) to the KF13 module.
LOGO FW is fine : LOGO connected. FW-Version: 2.6.0
